description: 公衆無線Wi-Fi(おんせんおおいたWi-Fi)設置箇所一覧 [telecom] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 大分県. 公衆無線Wi-Fi（おおいたおんせんWi-Fi）の利用可能スポット一覧です。 「おんせんおおいたWi-Fi」は、外国人旅行者の利便性の向上や県内の観光・交通情報の発信力強化などを主な目的とした、誰でも無料で利用できる公衆無線ＬＡＮサービスです。 ※利用可能時間は、１日あたり最大３時間（１５分×１２回）です。 ※本サービスの利用料は無料です... Coverage: 大分県. The portal files it under the publisher 大分県. Its tags are Wi-Fi, wifi, おんせんおおいたWi-Fi, 位置情報, 公衆無線LAN. It offers 2 resource(s) in csv, geojson. The portal shows 2025-04-17 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
